notes.title: Major update, "+Art" tab, and the release of the NEW season!
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings, dear friends. Before the release of the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3837620/Arcana_Heat_and_Cold_Season_3/"]new season[/url], I revised the old ones.
During the development, various artworks accumulated, which I added to the "[b]+Art[/b]" tab in the "[b]Gallery[/b]." Bonus art is SFW, but still very cool and cute. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38243237/1ed5fc90a0d70c78ea67818a6d6c0da64c731264.png"][/img]
I hope you enjoy the new art and the new season. Take care of yourself.[/p]

notes.title: Major Update + New Season Release!
notes.notes:
Hello, friends. Today is a big day for me.
First, a major update for season 1. Fixed a bunch of bugs, updated some pictures. 
And most importantly, the [b]correct economic system[/b] of the world in which the events take place has been implemented.

Yes, I still think that even in a hentai game, if you're going to write something, you have to do your best.
So the price tags in the game world are now quite logical and not abstract. Each gold coin has its own equivalent.

And also today was the [b]release of the New Season[/b]! It is already available on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2426310/Arcana_Heat_and_Cold_Stories/]Steam[/url]. I will be very glad if you've been waiting for it, and if you like it!
